name: bell
description: A gently squared bell with a separate hanging clapper in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The solid shell follows the same hanger, upright walls and flat lip. Separate clapper starts 1.7 units beneath the body. Vertical bounds y=1.65..22.35 balance top and bottom. Separately authored fill-only study; counters are fixed geometry. Not owner-approved.
